claim_reviews.review: “Paruh waktu” is a standard Indonesian equivalent.
“Separuh masa” is a standard Malaysian Malay equivalent.
The contrast is useful despite the shared alternative “sambilan.”

rationale: English sense is correct, and both answers are valid ordinary forms: Indonesian “paruh waktu” and Malaysian Malay “separuh masa.” The relation and cue alignment are appropriate. “Sambilan” is a credible shared alternative but does not make either answer incorrect.
